headline: Do Essex’s New Buybacks and Lower Guidance Reframe Its Real Estate Strategy Story (ESS)?
summary: In late July 2026, Essex Property Trust reported higher year-on-year second-quarter revenue of US$489.05 million but lower net income of US$62.46 million, trimmed its full-year 2026 net income guidance, and authorized a new US$500 million share repurchase program while continuing to pursue acquisitions and other investments.
